turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy in Mumbai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is this calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, my name is Sameer and I am calling from Vista Broadband regarding a special family plan for your area.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Broadband? I already have a connection in my house, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand sir, but our new high-speed plan is only nine thousand five hundred rupees for the entire year.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nine thousand five hundred? That sounds a bit expensive for me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It includes a free router upgrade and unlimited data for all your devices, sir.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know, I have to ask my son first about these things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is perfectly fine. Would it be okay if I send the plan details to your WhatsApp?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, you can send a message. I will check it later.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will send it right away, Mr. Reddy. Have a very nice day.
